Copper coils, covered barrels, campfire benches, and Knock Wood cups cluster under shelter. Laughter stops quickly when route danger is named, then returns changed. Some barrels are marked for grief, not sale. Leaf-drip, insects, distant wingbeats, and animal calls that stop or resume according to pressure, not comfort. Fermenting fruit, smoke, copper, wet bark, and sweet burn. Cups are warm and rough; barrel hoops leave rust on fingers. The forest is populated even when no NPC is present; silence, birds, insects, and tracks are actionable signals.
